title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
source_note: Synthetic job description authored for GitScore Milestone 8C evaluation. Not copied or paraphrased from any specific real job posting.
raw_text:
Embedded Firmware Engineer

Requirements:
- Strong C experience in embedded, resource-constrained environments
- Experience with FreeRTOS or another real-time operating system
- Familiarity with microcontroller peripherals such as SPI, I2C, and UART
- Experience debugging with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with CMake-based build systems
- Exposure to Verilog for hardware/firmware co-design
